name: Pinwheel Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with a neutral (hammer) grip at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Alternate arms in a continuous pinwheel motion.
Keep the elbows pinned to your sides. Hits the brachialis and forearms.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner dumbbell pull-pattern exercise for the biceps. Pinwheel Curl strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
